items.fromString:
Hey,

I need access to the old Hibernate SVN repository that was hosted at jboss, in the context of some work in relation with Legal.

I saw from various emails that the JBoss SVN repositories have been migrated to [https://anonsvn.jboss.org,|https://anonsvn.jboss.org,/] in readonly mode. Which is completely fine.

I saw in https://issues.redhat.com/browse/ORG-4304 that the migration was successful.

But if I try to access [https://anonsvn.jboss.org|https://anonsvn.jboss.org,/]... it seems the domain simply doesn't point to anything?

{{# curl [https://anonsvn.jboss.org/]}}
{{curl: (6) Could not resolve host: anonsvn.jboss.org}}

I did not see any announcement about decommissioning this domain. Did I miss it? Or is something broken?

If it was decommissioned, is there an archive somewhere? Could it perhaps be made available somewhere privately?

Note: if the intent is to eventually phase out the domain completely, it might be worth reaching out to [https://archive.softwareheritage.org/] .

Thanks.

items.fromString:
Implement and deploy "Feeds Aggregator" service (with MongoDB storage) to replace Borg and DCP. Use cloud ready technologies (Quarkus, ...) and deployment to OpenShift platform.

It would be responsible to crawl configured blogs (Borg now) and provide remote API  (REST API, GraphQL API, RSS Atom feeds API - provided by DCP now) to get and present aggregated blogs by distinct frontends.

Migration of all aggregated blogposts from DCP is part of this project! 

We should also add redirect of Atom Feed requests from dcp2 API to new API, base don analysis of current traffic to /feed API of DCP2

Outcome of this project allows:
* update www.jboss.org main page and https://www.jboss.org/blogs.html to use new API to show blogposts
* implement new planet.jboss.org frontend to use new API to show blogposts, Borg project is not used anymore at this domain and is completely decommissioned
* DCP decommissioning is not blocked by blogposts aggregation functionality anymore

Source repo: https://github.com/jbossorg/feedsaggregator

items.fromString:
https://developer.jboss.org/docs/DOC-10000 currently redirects to Jive plugin
https://developer.jboss.org/hfurl/redirectToHFURL.jspa?url=/docs/DOC-10000&params=
which based on DB mapping dynamically redirects to https://developer.jboss.org/wiki/IGetIOExceptionPingTimeoutHowDoIFixIt

The dynamic functionality
/hfurl/redirectToHFURL.jspa?url=/docs/DOC-10000&params= -> /wiki/IGetIOExceptionPingTimeoutHowDoIFixIt needs to be replaced by F5 configuration.
The mapping is stored in {{humanfriendlyurlmap}} table 
Column {{documentID}} contains {{DOC-10000}} part and {{hfTitle}} contains {{IGetIOExceptionPingTimeoutHowDoIFixIt}} part
items.toString:
https://developer.jboss.org/docs/DOC-10000 currently redirects to Jive plugin
https://developer.jboss.org/hfurl/redirectToHFURL.jspa?url=/docs/DOC-10000&params=
which based on DB mapping dynamically redirects to https://developer.jboss.org/wiki/IGetIOExceptionPingTimeoutHowDoIFixIt

The dynamic functionality
/hfurl/redirectToHFURL.jspa?url=/docs/DOC-10000&params= -> /wiki/IGetIOExceptionPingTimeoutHowDoIFixIt needs to be replaced by F5 configuration.
The mapping is stored in {{humanfriendlyurlmap}} table 
Column {{documentID}} contains {{DOC-10000}} part and {{hfTitle}} contains {{IGetIOExceptionPingTimeoutHowDoIFixIt}} part

*Solution*
However wget recursive download stores only /docs/ 
In this case we need to prepare a redirect mapping for /wiki/HFURL -> to /docs/DOC-XXX
and remove the /docs/DOC-XXX -> /hfurl/redirectToHFURL.jspa redirect

Update "RHT User profile metrics" query in DCP to work with SWEL data which do not use "channel" attribute anymore. {{by_channel}} aggregation have to use "aTacticIDExternal" attribute instead. Values of the "aTacticIDExternal" for current channels:
* infoq: 7016000000122iAAAQ
* dzone: 7016000000122iKAAQ
* conference: 701f2000000tjnwAAA
* bulkinvite: 701f2000000RieJAAS
* website: anything other (including empty/missing "aTacticIDExternal")

new filters should be connected by {{or}} to the existing based on channel to prevent need of all data reindex (or we should check if  "aTacticIDExternal" is in existing data also so we can remove channel based filter then)

items.fromString:
In some cases clicking on Login link user is redirected to httpss://planet.jboss.org (doubled ss).

How to reproduce:
# Visit http://planet.jboss.org in Safari
# Login
# Click on Logout link
# Click on HOME
# Click on login - you're redirected to sso.jboss.org and but then back to httpss://planet.jboss.org which is invalid

* Workaround: *
on gray page "Safari can't open ..." just go back and reload home page
